db:info.db:title: RequiresExpressionExample Class
db:info.db:titleabbrev: Test for C++20 concepts and requires clauses

db:abstract.db:para: A class demonstrating requires-expressions for ad-hoc constraints.

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: Requires-expressions use the nested requires requires(...) { ... } syntax to define constraints inline without defining a named concept.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> requires requires(T t) { t.size(); } int RequiresExpressionExample::getSize(const T &container)
db:section.db:para: Gets the size of container using a simple requires-expression.
Demonstrates a requires-expression that checks for a size() member function.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> requires requires(T t) { t.begin(); t.end(); } void RequiresExpressionExample::iterate(T &container)
db:section.db:para: Iterates over container using a requires-expression.
The requires-expression checks that the type has begin() and end() member functions, making it iterable.
